data_source.query: FROM logs-workshop.app-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-workshop.app.otel-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM logs-workshop.audit-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM traces-workshop.app-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)

config.title: App logs by schema (ECS vs OTel)

data_source.query: FROM logs-workshop.app-prod, logs-workshop.app.otel-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY labels.schema

FROM logs-workshop.app-prod, logs-workshop.app.otel-prod, logs-workshop.audit-prod, metrics-workshop.platform-prod, traces-workshop.app-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY labels.retention_class

config.title: Same incident, two schemas — ECS hits only on trace.id

data_source.query: FROM logs-workshop.app-prod | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE trace.id == "4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736" | KEEP @timestamp, message, log.level, service.name, trace.id, labels.schema | LIMIT 20
